text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after "Dream Fest" ended, the racing 
boom showed no signs of fading... The 
flame in people's hearts continued to 
burn.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"My fave is taking on an overseas 
challenge soon, you see!"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh... wait, don't tell me you're...ugh?!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I went and got... the plane tickets... 
Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa! Way to go♪ I mean, why didn't you 
tell me sooner! —I'm coming with you! When 
is it!??

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: In a good mood, aren't you, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked back—and was astonished. The 
legends, who were supposed to have 
returned to their own work, were standing 
right there!
choice_data_list: Everyone, why are you all here!?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"It just so happened that all three of us 
had the day off. We came to catch our 
breath, and here you were too."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah, mineral water for me, please.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
For me, mixed with milk, of course, if you 
please.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I'll have mine mixed with carrot juice!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's my first day off in a while, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer, you haven't 
been posting much on social media lately, 
have you? I feel lonely!
choice_data_list: Well, I've just been a bit busy...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is quite popular, after all, so that's 
only natural.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"So... what about your next race? Where 
will you be running?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I want to know too! Let's all go cheer 
for them together♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Do you hate it? Hehe... Don't say such 
lonely things.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No matter which path you take, I'll be 
watching over you. Watching the one and 
only hoofprints that belong solely to you 
two—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series continues on— with our 
hearts united as one.
